Package org.bsc.langgraph4j

Record Class GraphResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.bsc.langgraph4j.GraphResult
public record GraphResult(Object result, GraphResult.Type type) extends Record
Represents the unified result of a graph execution.

This class encapsulates different types of results that can be produced by a graph, such as interruption metadata, node output, checkpoint tags, or raw state data. It provides methods to check the type of the result and retrieve it safely.

    • from

      public static GraphResult from(Object result)
      Creates a GraphResult from the object returning by the AsyncGenerator obtained by StateGraph.stream() call.

      The method attempts to determine the type of the result and wrap it in a GraphResult. Supported types are:

      • GraphResult (returns the object itself)
      • Map (treated as state data)
      • NodeOutput
      • InterruptionMetadata
      • BaseCheckpointSaver.Tag
      If the input is null, an empty GraphResult is returned.

      Parameters:
      result - the object to wrap.
      Returns:
      a GraphResult instance.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the result type is not supported.

    • from

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      a GraphResult instance.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the generator is null.
